# Steel Flange

> Steel pipe flange resource and supply. Forged ASME B16.5 and B16.47, plate-cut AWWA C207, and custom dimensions out to 203 inches. Carbon steel A105 through high yield A694 grades F42 to F70, chrome-moly F11 through F91, plus stainless, duplex, and exotic alloys. Serving oil and gas, waterworks, power generation, petrochemical, chemical processing, and general industrial fabrication from a Houston-area supply operation.

## Site Structure

- /products: Flanges, pipe fittings, custom machining
- /standards: ASME B16.5 and B16.47, AWWA C207, ANSI B16.1, DIN EN 1092-1, API 605, MSS SP-44
- /materials: Carbon steel, stainless steel, alloy steel, exotic alloys
- /industries: Oil and gas, petrochemical, power generation, waterworks, chemical processing, mining, pulp and paper, food and beverage, agriculture, HVAC, marine, data centers
- /resources: Flange dimensions, CAD drawings, domestic vs import guidance, technical specs
- /tools: Bolt torque calculator, flange dimension calculator, pressure-temperature rating lookup
- /blog: Long-form technical articles on forged vs plate flanges, A105 vs A694 high yield, and custom large diameter flange specification

## Key Capabilities

- Sizes from 1/2 inch through 203 inches OD on custom work
- All standard ASME pressure classes Class 150 through Class 2500
- AWWA C207 Class B, D, E, F for waterworks service
- Material grades: A105, A350 LF2/LF3, A516-70, A36, A694 F42 through F70, F304/304L, F316/316L, F11, F22, F91, plus Hastelloy, Inconel, Monel, duplex 2205, super duplex 2507
- Forged and plate-cut production paths
- Custom machining: non-standard bores, overbore, special facings, RTJ grooves, weld overlay, hard facing
- Domestic melt with AIS and BABA documentation, import sourcing for cost-sensitive projects
